fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (42.0268,-93.4482) were ~2.3km off in a residential district. Correct facility is 1516 S D Avenue, Nevada IA 50201, confirmed via Ames Chamber/Panjiva/USDA FSIS listings (Burke Marketing Corporation). Locked center ~42.0085,-93.4392.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint visible at any perimeter road junction. Driveways from the bounding public roads run open into the campus paved yard. Marked false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small 1-3-vehicle-footprint guard booth at a defined truck entrance. Two small buildings sit near the NW driveway off the perimeter road, but they are larger office/maintenance-scale structures, not gate booths beside a controlled lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Diagonal SW dock bank shows ~12-14 trailers backed in; additional dock doors on north and east building faces. Total estimated 25-50 band (~35) - low confidence from overhead-only imagery, much of the roof is overexposed.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock clusters on different faces (diagonal SW bank and additional doors on the north/east faces) suggest separate ship/receive operations - inferred.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer storage: a ~20+ trailer row along the east edge plus drop rows along the north of the property, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide paved aprons and multiple open driveways give ample room to add bypass/express lanes.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs through northern Nevada IA but no spur reaches this plant, which sits on the south edge of town beside US-30.
